b1-karpatmedence-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Romans
b1-karpatmedence-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks which peoples lived in the Carpathian Basin before the Romans.
b1-karpatmedence-01.prompt: Name the two peoples and say where the Celts settled.
cues: Name the two peoples who lived here before the Romans
b1-karpatmedence-01.target: A rómaiak előtt pannon törzsek és kelták éltek itt. A kelták a folyók közelében letelepedtek.
b1-karpatmedence-01.english: Before the Romans, Pannonian tribes and Celts lived here. The Celts settled near the rivers.
b1-karpatmedence-01.canDo: I can name two peoples who lived in the Carpathian Basin before the Romans: the Pannonian tribes and the Celts.

b1-karpatmedence-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Romans on the Danube
b1-karpatmedence-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks how the Romans came to Pannonia.
b1-karpatmedence-02.prompt: Say what the Romans did, in order: the legions reached the Danube, they conquered the right bank and finally founded the province.
cues: Say that the legions reached the Danube
Say that the Romans conquered the right bank
Say that they finally founded Pannonia
b1-karpatmedence-02.target: A légiók elérték a Dunát, majd a rómaiak meghódították a Duna jobb partját, végül Pannónia tartományt alapítottak.
b1-karpatmedence-02.english: The legions reached the Danube, then the Romans conquered the right bank of the Danube, and finally they founded the province of Pannonia.
b1-karpatmedence-02.canDo: I can explain when and how the Romans conquered the western part of the Carpathian Basin.

b1-karpatmedence-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Migration Period
b1-karpatmedence-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what the népvándorlás was.
b1-karpatmedence-03.prompt: Say what the népvándorlás was and what the Slavs did while the Avars ruled.
cues: Say what the Slavs did while the Avars ruled
b1-karpatmedence-03.target: A népvándorlás az az időszak, amikor sok nép vándorolt át Európán. Míg az avarok uralkodtak, szláv csoportok letelepedtek a folyók mentén.
b1-karpatmedence-03.english: The népvándorlás was the period when many peoples migrated across Europe. While the Avars ruled, Slavic groups settled along the rivers.
b1-karpatmedence-03.canDo: I can explain what the népvándorlás (Migration Period) was.

b1-karpatmedence-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Lived Here Before?
b1-karpatmedence-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks who lived in the Carpathian Basin before the Magyars.
b1-karpatmedence-04.prompt: Name the peoples in the order they came: the Celts, then the Romans, then the Huns and the Avars.
cues: Say who followed in the Migration Period
b1-karpatmedence-04.target: A kelták éltek itt először, majd a rómaiak alapítottak tartományt. Később hunok és avarok követték egymást.
b1-karpatmedence-04.english: The Celts lived here first, then the Romans founded a province. Later the Huns and Avars followed one another.
b1-karpatmedence-04.canDo: I can summarize, in my own words, which peoples lived in the Carpathian Basin before the Magyars, in the order they arrived.

b1-karpatmedence-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Eve of 895
b1-karpatmedence-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what the situation was in the Carpathian Basin at the end of the 9th century.
b1-karpatmedence-05.prompt: Say that no single people ruled the whole basin and that the Magyar tribes set out from the east.
cues: Say that no single people ruled the whole basin
Say that many peoples lived side by side
Say that the Magyar tribes set out from the east
b1-karpatmedence-05.target: A 9. század végén egyetlen nép sem uralkodott az egész medencében. Sok nép és helyi uralkodó élt egymás mellett, és ekkor indultak el keletről a magyar törzsek.
b1-karpatmedence-05.english: At the end of the 9th century, no single people ruled the whole basin. Many peoples and local rulers lived side by side, and this is when the Magyar tribes set out from the east.
b1-karpatmedence-05.canDo: I can describe the political situation in the Carpathian Basin at the end of the 9th century, after the fall of the Avar Khaganate.

b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: From the Celts to 895
b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.scenario: At the end of your naturalization interview, the official asks for a short summary of the Carpathian Basin before the Magyars.
b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.prompt: Say who lived here, what the Romans founded, who followed in the Migration Period and what the Magyar tribes did at the end.
cues: Say who followed in the Migration Period
Say what the Magyar tribes did at the end
b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.target: A kelták éltek itt, majd a rómaiak tartományt alapítottak. A népvándorlás alatt hunok és avarok követték egymást, végül elindultak keletről a magyar törzsek.
b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.english: The Celts lived here, then the Romans founded a province. During the Migration Period the Huns and Avars followed one another, and finally the Magyar tribes set out from the east.
b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate the Kárpát-medence's pre-Magyar history: early peoples, Roman Pannonia, the Migration Period and the eve of the honfoglalás.
